longest.en: Triggers once when creating or updating a profile: 1.2 seconds into authorization, or 0.6 seconds into processing.
longest.zh: 创建或更新资料时触发一次：授权窗口打开 1.2 秒后，或处理开始 0.6 秒后。

longest.en: Applies once after approving a connection, creation or update. Cancelling keeps this setting.
longest.zh: 批准连接、创建或更新后生效一次；取消授权会保留此设置。

longest.en: Waiting for the wallet. Disconnecting or switching account cancels this operation.
longest.zh: 正在等待钱包返回。断开或切换账户会取消此操作。

longest.en: Let this app see your wallet identity. Publishing needs a separate confirmation.
longest.zh: 允许应用查看钱包身份；发布时另行确认。

longest.en: Your updated profile will become public. Your BAP ID will not change.
longest.zh: 更新后的资料将公开发布，BAP ID 保持不变。

longest.en: Your editing values are kept. Review them and try again when ready.
longest.zh: 已保留填写内容。核对后可重新尝试。

longest.en: Demo only. No wallet connection, signature or transaction is sent.
longest.zh: 仅作演示。不会连接钱包、签名或发送交易。

longest.en: No supported wallet was found. Open Yours Wallet, then try again.
longest.zh: 未发现支持的钱包。请打开 Yours Wallet 后重试。

longest.en: Start with your wallet. Your identity and your words stay yours.
longest.zh: 从钱包开始。身份与话语，都由你掌控。

longest.en: The operation did not complete. Your values are kept. Try again.
longest.zh: 操作未完成，已保留填写内容。请重试。

longest.en: Already published. Add the missing profile details to continue.
longest.zh: 身份已发布。补全资料后继续。

longest.en: You now have a place to stand. Your wallet remains in control.
longest.zh: 现在，你有了自己的坐标。钱包始终由你掌控。

longest.en: Changes are not saved. Keep editing, or discard them to leave.
longest.zh: 修改未保存。继续编辑，或放弃后离开。

longest.en: Your identity is unchanged. Check your wallet and try again.
longest.zh: 身份未改变。请检查钱包后重试。

longest.en: Choose an identity scenario, then connect or resolve again.
longest.zh: 选择身份场景后，连接钱包或重新解析。

longest.en: Try again, or disconnect and switch to another account.
longest.zh: 可重试，或断开后切换其他账户。

longest.en: Checking whether your wallet has a published identity.
longest.zh: 正在查询当前钱包是否已有公开身份。

longest.en: Review the details before confirming in your wallet.
longest.zh: 核对资料后，在钱包中确认。

longest.en: Account changed. Pending operations were cancelled.
longest.zh: 账户已切换，进行中的操作已取消。

longest.en: Update how you appear. Your BAP ID stays the same.
longest.zh: 更新展示资料，BAP ID 保持不变。

long.en: Triggers once when creating or updating a profile: 1.2 seconds into authorization, or 0.6 seconds into processing.
long.zh: 创建或更新资料时触发一次：授权窗口打开 1.2 秒后，或处理开始 0.6 秒后。
